field_notes.collector: auto = Supabase cron/edge function; agent = Claude run (weekly/monthly/quarterly); client = client enters in portal; manual = Martin or team
field_notes.layer: glance = 30-second view; proof = raw evidence with date and source; raw = data layer for agents only
field_notes.client_visible: true = shown in the client tab after Martin's release
field_notes.warning: yellow goes to the 08:05 standup; red goes at once by email alerts@741.studio -> martin@741.studio
field_notes.baseline: frozen comparison value; for Suriya the period 28.06.-23.09.2026 (before the relaunch)
field_notes.v1: true = part of version 1 (pilot Praxis Suriya)

metrics.definition: Taps on 'Anrufen' in the Google profile, per day, summed per week (Mon-Sun).
metrics.source: Google Business Profile performance via Local Falcon getLocalFalconGbpPerformanceMetrics (CALL_CLICKS)

warning.yellow: sum of M01+M02+M03 in the last complete week < 70 % of the baseline week average
warning.red: feed unreadable 2 days in a row (report as 'nicht lesbar', never as 0)

metrics.quarter_question: Did more visibility turn into more contact actions?
metrics.note: Google reports with about 3 days delay. Only complete weeks are compared. Counts taps, not answered calls.

metrics.name_de: Klicks auf deine Website aus dem Google-Profil
metrics.definition: Clicks on the website button in the Google profile.
metrics.quarter_question: Does the profile send people to the booking page?

metrics.definition: Requests for a route to the business address.
metrics.quarter_question: Where do people come from (geo pockets)?

metrics.definition: Sum of the four impression metrics (Maps and Search, mobile and desktop).

warning.yellow: last complete week < 70 % of baseline week average
warning.red: last complete week < 40 % of baseline week average for 2 weeks

metrics.note: Single-day spikes (Suriya 15.08.: 142 desktop Maps views) are marked, not removed.

metrics.definition: Each submit of the booking or contact form that reaches the portal table leads (channel = formular).
metrics.source: portal table leads (via edge function lead-intake, needs a site change with go)

warning.yellow: 0 form leads in 14 days while M02 > 0

metrics.quarter_question: Which pages and keywords bring real inquiries?
metrics.note: Store only contact data, channel, page and status. Never symptoms or case details (health data, Art. 9 GDPR; same rule as portal-leads-crm).

metrics.name_de: Anfragen per Telefon, Mail oder WhatsApp
metrics.definition: Leads the client enters in the tab 'Anfragen' (channel telefon/mail/whatsapp) with the question 'Wie hast du uns gefunden?'.
metrics.quarter_question: How large is the hidden phone share?

metrics.definition: M05 + M06 minus entries marked spam or 'passt nicht' (fit = no).
Leads with status 'gebucht' (first paid appointment or programme start).
metrics.source: portal table leads (status set by client)

warning.yellow: no status update for 14 days while open leads exist -> one reminder card

metrics.note: If missing: show 'fehlt seit <Datum>'. Never estimate.

metrics.definition: Sum of the value the client enters per booked lead (first booking or package price).
metrics.source: portal leads.mandate_value_eur (rename to value_eur in the tracking view)

metrics.definition: 741 programme fee of the month + paid ads spend of the month (if any).
metrics.collector: manual (fee set once per client) + auto (ads)

metrics.definition: M10 / M08 for the same month. Empty when M08 is missing.
M08 / M07 for the same month.
Share of the 49 grid points where the profile is in places 1-3, per locked keyword.

warning.yellow: drop >= 15 points vs previous scan on any locked keyword
warning.red: drop >= 40 points on the main keyword

metrics.note: Client text never says SoLV. It says 'An X von 49 Punkten auf der Karte bist du unter den ersten 3'.

metrics.definition: Average place over the grid points where the profile is found.

warning.yellow: worse by >= 2 places vs previous scan

metrics.definition: Number of grid points (of 49) where the profile is in the top 20.
Top 3 competitors per locked keyword with top-3 share, average rank, review count and rating.
metrics.source: Local Falcon competitor report (auto with every scan)

warning.yellow: a new business enters the top 3

metrics.quarter_question: Who is new, who lost ground, who disappeared?

metrics.definition: Total Google reviews and average stars.
New reviews per calendar month (date_created), rolling 3-month average.

warning.yellow: 0 new reviews in 60 days, or own 3-month average < median of the top-3 competitors

metrics.quarter_question: Do we keep pace with the leaders?

metrics.definition: Monthly delta of review counts of the top-3 competitors per main keyword.
metrics.source: Local Falcon competitor data per scan (review count) - delta between scans
metrics.quarter_question: Review gap to the market leader
metrics.note: Falcon review count 0 can mean 'no data' (Stürzl audit finding). Treat 0 as unknown and verify.

metrics.definition: Reviews without owner reply.
metrics.note: 741 does not answer reviews (memory no-review-answering). Info only.

metrics.definition: Search Console clicks, 28 days vs previous 28 days, plus per focus keyword.
metrics.source: Search Console API via service account (scripts/gsc-client-export.mjs)
metrics.quarter_question: Content saturation, cut or refresh candidates

metrics.definition: Clicks and impressions per page, 90 days.

metrics.name_de: Platz in der normalen Google-Suche (unabhängige Messung)
metrics.definition: Organic position, mobile, client city, per locked keyword and 'keyword + Stadt'.

warning.yellow: drop out of the top 10 on a locked keyword

metrics.note: Runs inside the monthly agent run (laptop) until a fixed-IP runner exists.

metrics.definition: GA4 sessions per day and key events (form submit, tel click).
metrics.source: GA4 Data API via service account (account-level viewer)

warning.red: 0 sessions for a day while the 7-day average > 5

metrics.definition: HTTP status of the homepage and the booking page.

warning.red: not 200 in 2 checks in a row

metrics.definition: Booking page contains the form element and its submit endpoint; no test submits.
Daily diff of name, address, phone, website, hours, primary category against the locked master (NAP source of truth) plus pending Google updates.
Verification state of the profile.
Days since the last released weekly card or portal note.

warning.yellow: card not released by Wednesday 12:00, or > 10 days without update

metrics.quarter_question: Were we never in the dark?

metrics.definition: Share of AI answers (ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews) that name the business, 3x3 grid, main keyword.
Referring domains of the client and the top-3 competitors, new in the quarter.
metrics.quarter_question: Which links were built (own and competitors)?

metrics.definition: Client's own estimate: free slots per week and maximum patients per week (Suriya: max 12-16 per week).
Monthly search volume history (12-24 months) for the locked keywords and main topics.
metrics.source: DataForSEO keyword volume history + GSC impressions by month

metrics.definition: Postcode or town per lead (client enters town only), aggregated per quarter.
metrics.quarter_question: New geo pockets, CRM data match

locked_scan_config.rule: One locked config per client. A change needs Martin's go and is logged with date and reason. Scans with another config are stored but not compared.
